name: Jasperlode Mine
summary: In north-central Elwynn, Jasperlode Mine lies lost to kobolds and giant spiders. Its shafts once supplied Stormwind City with vital iron and minerals, but the resource-strapped kingdom cannot reclaim them.

sections.title: A Lost Resource in Elwynn
sections.body: Jasperlode Mine once supplied Stormwind with a steady wealth of minerals, alongside nearby Fargodeep. With the kingdom's forces stretched thin by outside threats and unrest, local garrisons cannot protect the shafts. Kobolds seized their chance, drove out the human miners, and hoarded stolen gold and tallow candles.

sections.title: Dangers in the Deep
sections.body: Deep within Jasperlode Mine, mine spiders have taken hold beneath the timber supports. A massive matriarch called Mother Fang leads them. The spiders prey on trespassing kobolds and unwary prospectors, making any attempt to salvage the mine dangerous.

faq.answer: Stormwind's army is spread thin across the realm, leaving rural outposts like Goldshire short on manpower. Kobolds swarmed the dig sites once the human miners lost their guards.

faq.q: What is the difference between Jasperlode and Fargodeep?
faq.answer: Fargodeep Mine lies south near the Maclure and Stonefield farms. Jasperlode sits north in the foothills near the river. Both are major Elwynn mineral sites lost to kobolds.

faq.q: What lurks in the back of the mine?
faq.answer: Predatory mine spiders lurk in the deepest shafts, led by a massive arachnid called Mother Fang. Even the kobolds avoid their webbed caverns.

faq.q: Why hasn't Marshal Dughan cleared the mine?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan lacks the troops for a prolonged clearing underground. With Defias river patrols, gnoll incursions, and garrison duties to cover, the local militia must rely on traveling adventurers to scout and cull the threats inside.

angles.text: Jasperlode's mineral veins draw prospectors willing to face kobold pickaxes and spider webs to stake a claim.
Stormwind needs Jasperlode's raw metal to maintain its equipment supplies while the kingdom's borders face constant peril.
